constraints: pAdjustMethod = BH, selection by padj not p or LFC (R-0010@91a5, R-0043@f652)
ora_min_significant_genes = 50; fallback = fgsea preranked on full list ranked by 'stat' (R-0103@93aa, R-0099@0a77)
collection_pin = GO.db 3.23.1 named with release in report (R-0051@01ca)
steps.description: Parse de_results.csv (12,000 rows; gene, base_mean, log2_fold_change, log2_fo..., padj...). State the input contrast (treated vs control; reference level and sign convention as read from the table) per R-0110@41cb. Select significant genes by the adjusted p-value cutoff (padj < 0.05, reported), never by unadjusted p or fold change alone (R-0043@f652). Universe = all tested genes in the table (R-0046@a0ac, R-0054@801e). Map symbols to Entrez with org.Hs.eg.db (GO.db 3.23.1 annotation release), report the unmapped share and many-to-one handling (R-0101@06c8). Run clusterProfiler enrichGO with ontology = 'BP', pAdjustMethod = 'BH', minGSSize = 15, maxGSSize = 500, universe = mapped tested genes; pin GO.db version in the report (collection_pin, R-0095@492a). Direction handling is stated: run the ORA on the pooled significant list as the primary answer, with up- and down-regulated lists as stated secondary checks (R-0109@fe3e). Reduce redundant significant terms with rrvgo semantic similarity and report representative terms, keeping the full table as supplement (R-0052@620a). If fewer than ~50 genes pass padj < 0.05, do NOT run ORA on the short list: instead run fgsea preranked on the full 12,000-gene list ranked by the DESeq2 Wald statistic ('stat' column; stated tie rule: stable order of tied values), with GO BP sets of 15-500 genes and BH adjustment, and report that the ranked method is the primary answer in that case (R-0103@93aa, R-0045@f652, R-0099@0a77). GO BP is the collection the question asks for; no additional collection is added.
acceptance_criteria: Significant-gene list size at padj < 0.05 reported; ORA path vs ranked-fallback path chosen accordingly and stated
Universe = tested genes (12,000), never the genome; unmapped identifier share reported
enrichGO BP table with term, OR, NES or OR ratio, p, BH-adjusted p, gene counts; or fgsea table if fallback triggered
rrvgo-reduced representative terms with similarity threshold stated; full table saved as supplement
GO.db version and clusterProfiler version recorded in outputs

Representative GO BP terms listed with member genes and statistics
Reproducibility record (sessionInfo, versions, collection version) stored with results
Method-dependence caveat and the ranked-vs-ORA choice explicitly stated

plan.title: GO BP over-representation of AD DE genes
plan.analytical_narrative: The user asks which GO biological processes are over-represented among significant genes of the delivered treated-vs-control DESeq2 results table (12,000 genes x 8 cols, treated vs control, 6 vs 6 unpaired, single batch). Because the DE table is already delivered and counts are also present, the plan (a) runs a sample-structure QC on the delivered counts as the inherited check that R-0110 requires before enrichment on a delivered results table, and (b) runs a GO BP over-representation analysis with clusterProfiler enrichGO using the tested genes as universe, mapping symbols to Entrez with org.Hs.eg.db, with rrvgo semantic reduction of redundant terms. A significant-gene list below ~50 triggers the stated fallback to fgsea preranked on the Wald statistic. GO.db 3.23.1, clusterProfiler 4.20.0, org.Hs.eg.db 3.23.1, fgsea 1.38.0 and rrvgo 1.24.0 are present in the environment.

steps.method: vst blind PCA and sample distance heatmap
clusterProfiler enrichGO over-representation on significant genes, rrvgo term reduction
reproducibility record and enrichment report fields
